observations: 410 aa bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis enzyme with 49.6% identity and 97.1% query coverage to reviewed Bacillus subtilis CoaBC (O35033).
Contains an N-terminal flavoprotein domain (PF02441, residues 2-177) and a C-terminal DFP/phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase domain (PF04127, residues 186-395).
